Hello, Hexxet here,

This comic follows the story of the game "A Spell for All". Visit Glenvale, a town with a dark history that is about to reemerge as you get your hands on the spell book of the infamous Warlock Kurndorf! :)

If you like the series, you can support it via my Subscribestar: https://subscribestar.art/hexxet
